village.note: 青石村: the stone-slab road from 山坳 (west) runs east past the work station at the village's mouth (well, carts, a hut, the slope up north-east) to the foot of the gravel street; the street runs north past 沈记商行 (east), a house (west), the crossroads with the lane east, another house, the crossroads by the 土地庙 (west) and the 工匠's house (east, its door on the lane), then fades into an overgrown path north to the cave. The lane leads east to the little square with its great banyan (houses north and south, the 村长's to the south) and on to the quarry's yard under the cut cliff (an empty house north, the station's huts, stable and hay to the south). Shrubs south of the road.

mountain.note: North of 青石村: the gravel path ends at the hill's foot before a thick wooden door chained across the cave mouth; the low, freezing cave runs north through the hill and comes out on a desolate mountain road, cliff wall east and a bottomless chasm west, that winds north to its end: rock walls, a cave opening east (the 迷阵) with a painting above it, a mossy great stone door north. Behind it the stone room, the 大厅 north of it (only 绝尘子's apprentices pass), the east stone room with its prayer mats (from it one way west into the hall) and its secret door south to the stream, whose hidden path west through the bushes leads one way back into the stone room.

maze.note: 迷阵 (eight0-7, closed): each 卦's room is a clearing in the mist, drawn after its text, with a way off each side; walking off a side takes the LPC exit (a passage on this map): back into the same clearing from the far side (困), back the way one came (涉), on (生) or into 绝地 (死). Clearings lie far apart so the camera shows one at a time. The 路牌 in each reads its 卦.
